function.name: LHashValOfNameSysA
function.description: This function calculates a hash value for a given string, considering the system kind and locale ID. It uses different lookup tables and offsets depending on the primary language ID derived from the locale ID.

parameters.name: skind
parameters.description: This parameter represents the kind of system. It determines the mask used in the hash calculation.

parameters.name: lcid
parameters.description: This parameter represents the locale identifier. It is used to determine the primary language ID, which influences the lookup table and offset used in the hash calculation.

parameters.name: lpStr
parameters.description: This parameter is the string for which the hash value is calculated.

function.return_type: ULONG. This represents the calculated hash value for the given string, considering the system kind and locale ID.

function.name: LHashValOfNameSys
function.description: This function converts a wide character string to a new character string, computes the hash value of the string in the context of a specified locale and system, and then frees the allocated memory.

parameters.name: str
parameters.description: Pointer to the wide character string to be converted and hashed.

function.return_type: ULONG. It represents the computed hash value of the string. If the input string is NULL, the function returns 0.
